description:
Dress for your destination, not for the ride. No more worrying about your favourite wide-leg trousers getting stuck, the enclosed chain cover loves your flowy pants as much as you do. It provides ultimate protection for both your outfit and your cargo bike's chain or belt. Hop on in, enjoy a worry-free ride and arrive looking as fresh as when you left.

We believe safety should look stunning. By integrating the rear light directly into the fender of the FamilyNext², we’ve created a clean, modern look that blends seamlessly with its new rear design. It ensures optimal visibility from behind, making sure you and your precious cargo are clearly seen by other road users, day or night.

Sharing the ride has never been easier. Whether it’s your turn to drop off the kids or your partner’s turn for the grocery run, switching riders is now completely effortless. The new, user-friendly seatclamp makes adjusting your saddle height a breeze. With a quick and smooth adjustment, you can find your perfect riding position in seconds. No tools, no hassle. Just a comfortable, custom ride for whoever takes the handlebars next.

We left everything that makes the FamilyNext technically top-of-the-line and highly loved exactly as it is, but we completely redesigned the rear. This to elevate your comfort as a rider to an even higher level. The FamilyNext² features a sleeker and tougher rear frame, internally routed cables in the handlebar, an integrated rear light in the fender, a fully enclosed chain guard, a handy new seat clamp, and an integrated SP Connect system for your phone.

The Urban Arrow FamilyNext² is available in black and green.

The FamilyNext² is equipped with a fully enclosed chain guard. Because of this, you don't have to worry about wide trousers, long coats, or dresses getting caught in the chain or belt, or grease splashing onto your clothes. Note: Just like with other bicycles, your clothing can still get caught in the spokes if coat guards are not installed.

That depends on the accessory. Because the front side and the EPP box have the same dimensions and iconic shape, current FamilyNext accessories mounted to the front of the box (such as the rain cover, car seat adapter, and boxcover) fit the FamilyNext² perfectly. Accessories for the rear, such as the Rear Carrier Essential, do not fit and have been redesigned for the FamilyNext². View all accessories here.

In addition to the FamilyNext accessories that are compatible with the FamilyNext², we are also launching a battery lock and a rear carrier specifically designed for the FamilyNext². Keep an eye on the accessory page for current availability.

The battery lock for the FamilyNext² will be available starting September 2026. Want to be the first to know when the lock is available? Sign up for our newsletter here and we'll keep you directly updated on current availability.

The specially designed rear carrier for the FamilyNext² is expected in August 2026.

No, due to the new design of the rear frame, the standard Lockride is no longer compatible with the FamilyNext². We have designed our own battery lock to protect your battery against theft.

No, the FamilyNext² does not come standard with a built-in GPS module, but it is fully compatible. We recommend the official Urban Arrow Connected module to optimally secure and track your cargo bike via our own Urban Arrow app. Prefer a different GPS solution? The FamilyNext² is also compatible with the Bosch ConnectModule (BCM) and the Tracefy system. Ask your Urban Arrow dealer for the best option for you and have it installed upon delivery to properly secure and insure your bike.

Yes, that is certainly possible. Your Urban Arrow dealer can easily order the Bosch Kiox 300 display for you and professionally install it on the FamilyNext².

The unladen weight of the Urban Arrow FamilyNext² is 55.6 kg.

Starting from its launch on July 30, 2026, the FamilyNext² will be available in a limited edition in the Netherlands, Belgium, & Germany. Contact your local dealer for current availability.
